html:
We are thrilled to participate at Taiwan Smart Agriweek on 11-13 September 2024!

Held at TaiNEX 1, Taipei, Taiwan- the event serves as the Asia-only and the Taiwan-largest international B-2-B platform that spans all agriculture sectors with a focus on smart technology and sustainability. The event encompasses five major themes—AgriTech, AgriLivestock, AgriFresh, AgriGreen and Int’l Aquaculutre and Fisheries Expo Taiwan. What makes this even more special is that the event is set to celebrate its remarkable 10th edition this year.

Learn more about the show here -> https://www.taiwanagriweek.com/en/
